changes.old: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for $1310909d. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer $1310914s1 Holy damage and refund $s2% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for $1310912s1. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.
changes.new: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for $1310909d. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for $1310912s1. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

changes.old: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by $m2%, and all other spells by $m1%.
changes.new: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by $s1%.

changes.old: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by $s1%.
changes.new: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by $s1%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by $s2%.

changes.old: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for $d.
changes.new: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for $d, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to $s1, your Flash of Light by up to $s2, and your Holy Shock by up to $s3. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

changes.old: Increases your total Stamina by $s1% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by ${$m2/-1000} sec.
changes.new: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by ${$m2/-1000} sec, and reduces the duration of Forbearance by ${$m1/-1000} sec.
Reduces the duration of Stun and Charm effects on you by $s1%.

changes.old: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by $s1%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
changes.new: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for $1311701d, stacking up to $1311701u times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.

changes.old: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by $s1%.
changes.new: Increases the physical damage you deal by $s1%, and reduces all threat you generate by $m2% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

changes.old: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by ${$m1/-3*$440667m1}, and increase your Attack Power by $m1% for $440667d.
changes.new: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by ${$m1/-3*$440667m1} for $440667d.

changes.old: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by $s1%.
changes.new: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by $m1%.

changes.old: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore $m1 Mana, increased by $m2% per level the attacker is above you, up to ${$m2*$m3}%.
changes.new: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by ${$m1/-1000} sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for $1328551d.

changes.old: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by $s1%.
changes.new: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

changes.old: Increases your spell damage by up to $m1% of your Intellect.
changes.new: Increases your spell damage by up to $m1% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by ${$m2/-1000}.1 sec.
